heading: Service of process
lead: The corporation shall have a designated agent to receive service of process for the corporation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15130836:5203(a)(4).Oct. 26, 1992, Pub. L. 102–522, title II, § 204(a)(4), 106 Stat. 3419. The words “at all times” are omitted as unnecessary and for consistency in the revised title. The word “have” is substituted for “maintain” for consistency in the revised title.
